authorship_disclosure: Reviewer authored train-a and dev/test corpus portions and their faults. This is independent review of root-authored publication content and package consistency, not an additional independent corpus-quality gold review.
scope: Local built intent-role-separation.html#tracker-lora-pilot, frozen milestone and grouped validation, referenced evidence and downloadable ZIP. Read-only review; no model inference or training run; report is the only file written.

checks.name: Page quantities against compiled records
checks.details: Parsed all 650 compiled records, counted unique families, language, fault annotations and empty targets; all displayed split quantities agree. 65 faults replace source decisions, not 65 extra exported rows.

checks.name: Publication and validation snapshot timing
checks.details: Both snapshots are 2026-10-24 08:19:43 Halifax (11:19:43 UTC). Frozen formal result is running; log shows 5 optimizer updates and 80 microsteps before snapshot. Page says running at this snapshot and no final save/reload or held-out result; it does not claim current live status or completion.

checks.name: Engineering receipts and limitations
checks.details: 650 no-truncation and zero prompt-supervision receipts match SFT hashes; offload smoke has two optimizer steps and exact tested save/reload logits. Failed dtype and controlled runtime stop remain disclosed. These are identified as engineering checks, not tracking benefit.

checks.name: Prospective comparison
checks.details: Locked protocol specifies one epoch, same pinned NF4 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct model, adapter on/off, 100 inputs per arm and 200 assigned calls. Page describes this as future comparison; rollout and final-answer benefit remain untested.

checks.name: No unmeasured quality claims
checks.details: Read entire new section and historical transition. It identifies model-authored/model-reviewed fictional labels, no human gold, no measured omission reduction, synthetic blind spots, domain overlap, short test histories and incomplete fault coverage.

checks.name: Historical wording and immutable evidence
checks.details: Explicit notice before old present-tense assertions identifies pending ownership, readiness and collection as an earlier snapshot. All three earlier ZIPs are byte-identical to committed pre-build versions via binary git show.

checks.name: Download completeness and integrity
checks.details: 139 unique pinned source records plus milestone and validation produce 141 unique ZIP entries. All 139 source hashes and all 141 source/export index entries match. All validation evidence and 8 new-section links resolve. Three SFT downloads preserve the actual original bytes and manifest hashes.

checks.name: Export path and sensitive-file checks
checks.details: Every ZIP entry is a contained relative path with approved text suffix and no traversal, selected sensitive filenames, model-weight filenames, drive-root paths or common API/private-key token signatures. Actual package whitelist inspected; text-only evidence includes hashes of model weights, not weight files.

review_attempts.outcome: No report accepted: root added publication_checks to validation while review was running, temporarily making source and built index differ. No corpus or research-result mismatch was found.
After rebuild, repeated complete source/export/ZIP checks; all exact bindings agree.

limitations: Local content/package review only; does not verify the deployed site, browser rendering, or later mutable training status. Browser and HTTP checks in publication_checks are root receipts, not independent visual tests by this reviewer.
Exact snapshot time is provided in linked milestone/validation JSON; visible section shows date and explicitly calls state a snapshot.

Token/key pattern checks are finite checks, not proof arbitrary secrets cannot exist. Package consists of authored research text/code/JSON evidence; no model weights or known credential files were included.
Non-SFT export copies sanitize machine-local paths and normalize line endings, so export hashes can differ from source hashes; export-index records both. SFT files are byte-identical.
Independent model review and executable checks do not establish human semantic gold, tracker omission reduction, long-history performance or user benefit.
No live model telemetry was queried. Zero held-out calls is the frozen milestone declaration corroborated by prospective lock and parent status; this review does not assert a future live call count.
